items.title: Apple finally fixed Siri. So why does it feel anticlimactic?
items.summary: Apple’s long-awaited AI overhaul finally makes Siri the assistant it was always supposed to be. Siri AI is genuinely useful, yet it arrives at a moment when simply being a capable AI assistant no longer feels revolutionary.
